profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Airbnb
profile.summary:
I'm currently a Senior Software Engineer at Airbnb. 

I thrive on solving complex technical challenges, enforcing high standards for API design, and leveraging my technical leadership to deliver value at scale. I am passionate about building impactful products and continuously advancing my skills in cutting-edge technologies.

Major: Electrical and Computer Engineering

positions.title: Software Development Engineer III
positions.description:
Amazon Global Procurement Technology
Amazon FireTV
Amazon Luna

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: CAKE provides a SaaS-based solution for advertisers and publishers to track and manage their digital spend. CAKE’s multi-channel, enterprise suite of tools offer everything needed for a complete view of the digital customer journey, from acquisition to conversion.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Worked closely with various technical and product managers to develop scientific and eCommerce web apps hosted on Microsoft Azure. Site and apps were developed primarily in C#, jQuery, KnockoutJS, HTML, and CSS.  Responsibilities also included maintaining and improving the very large C# and JavaScript code base, pushing changes on a weekly basis to Microsoft Azure, and actively participating in product discussion/design meetings.
